developer.text: Tandem Technology, Inc. Founder & CEO is Sahir Jaggi. Clinical Intelligence led by Adam Harris, MD and Kathleen Alvarez, NP.

availability.text: Available in the United States; availability abroad not clearly specified.

summary.text: Tandem is an AI-powered platform that automates end-to-end medication access workflows (prior authorization submission, appeals, pharmacy routing, affordability/patient assistance enrollment, and patient communication). Integrates with provider EHRs; offered free to providers and patients (per developer materials).

medical_purpose.text: Automate steps of obtaining prior authorization for medications, including PA form generation/submission, appeals, pharmacy navigation, and patient communication.

acceptable_input.text: Electronic prescriptions (structured), clinical records/notes (unstructured), payer rules, insurance data, historical outcomes, and patient communications.
Inputs include structured and unstructured clinical/admin data; outputs include structured forms, letters, routing instructions, portal updates, and SMS messages.

Typical workflow includes e-prescribing to Tandem from the EHR, optional EHR integration for record retrieval, AI-generated PA form creation, provider review/approval, submission and follow-up, appeals generation with provider review, assistance program enrollment, pharmacy routing, and patient text updates.

output.text: Completed PA forms, payer follow-up coordination, appeal letters (clinician-approved), enrollment workflows, pharmacy routing, and real-time patient status communications via text; staff dashboards.

role_in_decision_making.text: Low-to-moderate; errors/delays could affect medication access; designed with human-in-the-loop provider review.
Automate steps of obtaining prior authorization for medications, including PA form generation/submission, appeals, pharmacy navigation, and patient communication.

intended_users.text: Physicians, nurse practitioners, and practice staff at outpatient practices; also used in workflows involving patients waiting to receive medications.
No specialized technical knowledge described; requires provider e-prescribing capability.

target_patient_population.text: U.S. patients requiring medications with prior authorization.

known_failure_modes.text: Described limitations include scope focused on medication PAs (not all categories), variability in performance for complex cases or non-responsive patients, not a full replacement for PA specialists, and limited public disclosure of model error rates.

unsupported_clinical_scenarios.text: No formal warnings specified; platform notes include: electronic prescription workflows only; optional EHR integration; manual upload required without integration; provider review/approval before submissions; administrative automation tool that does not replace clinical judgment.

performance.summary.text: HIPAA-compliant; SOC 2 Type II certified; no reported breaches/incidents in cited materials; regulatory context includes CMS interoperability/prior authorization rules.
Administrative + human review mitigates clinical risk; security certifications provide assurance of controls.

ongoing_monitoring_plan.text: Continuous improvement described as platform scales.

scheduled_updates.text: Continuous improvement described as platform scales.

regulatory_approval_status.text: No FDA clearance or approval specified or required (administrative workflow automation). Platform is described as HIPAA-compliant and SOC 2 Type II certified; not classified as a medical device by Tandem.
